sm_top.sm: Two Libyan naval officers died of wounds from a drone attack on a Russian warship in Benghazi port.
Iran conducted missile and drone attacks on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain, causing two injuries and debris damage.
NATO deploys AWACS surveillance aircraft to Poland following Russian missile incursions and airspace violations.
A skyscraper in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, was struck by a Houthi missile, resulting in 11 injuries.
Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip resulted in reported deaths.
Multiple oil tankers and an LNG carrier were damaged by naval mines and missile attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi leadership threatened to strike Jeddah and other Saudi ports in response to regional tensions.
Iran claims its air defenses shot down US drones near the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russian drone strike on an apartment building in the Kyiv region killed at least 14 people.
Haitian authorities reported a major anti‑gang operation that killed at least 54 suspected gang members and injured two.
Two Libyan naval officers died from wounds sustained in a Ukrainian drone attack.
A Russian merchant vessel damaged by drones in the Gulf of Finland returned to St Petersburg.
The Saudi-led coalition reports striking a Yemeni port city, while Houthis threaten retaliation.
Russian attacks across Ukraine over the past day kill 9, injure 59, and damage a thermal power plant.
The ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people.
A Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia killed two people and wounded dozens, including children.
Saudi-led coalition intercepted two drones in the Eastern Province following a Houthi claim of an attack on the Ras Tanura refinery.
Multiple tankers and an LNG carrier were damaged by naval mines and missile attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi forces advanced toward Aden as Yemeni forces fortified defensive positions.
A Ukrainian strike damaged the Kerch Strait Bridge linking Russia and Crimea.
RSF drone strikes in Sudan's Blue Nile state killed 19 people.
Airstrikes hit Hodeidah, Yemen, killing 17 civilians at telecommunications infrastructure.
Ukrainian drones struck two oil refineries in Samara, Russia.
Houthis claimed a direct hit on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery.
Saudi-led coalition intercepted two Houthi ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh.
A Russian attack on Bila Tserkva damaged commercial infrastructure and resulted in one fatality.
A Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv hit a shopping center, injuring three people.
A ship was reportedly hit in a drone strike off the coast of Libya.
Dozens were killed in land dispute attacks in Nigeria's Niger state.
A Ukrainian Flamingo missile strike destroyed a workshop at a key Russian missile factory in Russia.
The Russian Ministry of Defense claims its air defenses intercepted 699 Ukrainian drones overnight, including 355 over the Moscow region.
Russian air defenses shot down 10 Ukrainian drones headed for Moscow, according to the mayor.
Iran claims its air defenses destroyed two US drones in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran launched missile and drone attacks against Bahrain and US bases in the Gulf region.
At least 64 people were killed in weekend attacks in Niger State, Nigeria.
Ukrainian forces struck the Savasleyka airfield in Russia, damaging five aircraft, including three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.
Suspected militants killed at least 30 people in an attack in Niger State, Nigeria.
A Ukrainian sea drone attack on a Russian warship in Benghazi killed two Libyan naval officers, prompting threats of retaliation.
Russian strikes killed seven people across Ukraine, while Ukrainian strikes hit three Russian oil refineries.
Pakistani forces' shelling in Balochistan's Mastung district left dozens dead and displaced 70,000 residents.
